description: Reservatórios do Semiárido Brasileiro: Hidrologia, Balanço Hídrico e Operação is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). No contexto de um cenário de estiagem, que se estende desde o ano de 2010 até o presente ano de 2017, atingindo de forma mais intensa o Semiárido Brasileiro, a Agência Nacional de Águas analisou os problemas e as potencialidades dos grandes sistemas de reservatórios da região, englobando um total de 204 reservatórios, com capacidade ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are balanço hídrico, Semiárido, reservatórios, açude, hidrologia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
